SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_accident1(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target10 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result10 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target11 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result11 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target12 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result12 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target01 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result01 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target02 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result02 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target03 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result03 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target04 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result04 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target05 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result05 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target06 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result06 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target07 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result07 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target08 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result08 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  target09 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result09 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_accident1 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_accident1 
(
SELECT
  @id,a.hospcode
	,CONCAT(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
  ,COUNT(DISTINCT a.hospcode,a.pid,a.seq) target
	,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) result
  ,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(10) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m10
	,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(10) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r10
  ,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(11) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m11
	,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(11) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r11
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(12) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m12
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(12) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r12
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(1) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m1
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(1) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(2) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m2
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(2) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(3) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m3
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(3) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(4) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m4
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(4) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(5) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m5
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(5) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r5
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(6) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m6
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(6) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r6
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(7) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m7
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(7) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r7
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(8) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m8
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(8) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r8
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(9) ,concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) m9
,COUNT(DISTINCT if(MONTH(datetime_serv) in(9) AND s.typeout in(4,5,6),concat(a.hospcode,'-',a.pid,'-',a.seq),NULL)) r9
FROM 
	tmp_accident a LEFT JOIN tmp_service s ON a.HOSPCODE=s.hospcode AND a.PID=s.pid AND a.SEQ=s.seq
INNER JOIN chospital h ON a.hospcode=h.hoscode
WHERE h.provcode in (@prov_c) AND a.AETYPE in(1) AND a.AEPLACE in(7,8) 
AND DATE_FORMAT(datetime_serv,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY a.hospcode
);
